Rulebooks shipped with plancap

Source: R/examples.R
rulebook_example.Rd

plancap ships the Exampleton rulebook (for the synthetic town from exampleton()) and, as dated worked examples, rulebooks for three New Zealand councils: Auckland (Auckland Unitary Plan, operative), Christchurch and Wellington. The council rulebooks were converted from the capacityengine project and carry every rule citation; check the plan itself before relying on any value.

Usage

rulebook_example(name = "exampleton", validate = FALSE)

rulebook_examples()

rulebook_example_path(name = "exampleton")

Arguments

name

Name of a shipped rulebook; see rulebook_examples().

validate

Whether to validate on reading (the council rulebooks give warnings for values whose citation was not recorded).

Value

rulebook_example() returns a plancap_rulebook; rulebook_examples() the available names; rulebook_example_path() the file path.

Examples

rulebook_examples()
#> [1] "auckland"     "christchurch" "exampleton"   "wellington"  
rb <- rulebook_example("exampleton")
rb
#> <plancap rulebook> Exampleton District Plan
#> exampleton-dp-2026 | Exampleton | NZ | as at 2026-01-01
#> 7 zones, 4 overlays, 1 area, 2 bonuses, 1 entitlement; 3 unmodelled rules.
